summary.text: Erich Obermayr is the Democratic candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 39 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Blayne Osborn.
A retired field archaeologist, he ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Obermayr was born in Baraboo, Wisconsin, earned a high school diploma from El Paso High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona in 1986.
He previously worked as a field archaeologist, in cultural resource management, and in historic and archaeological public interpretation.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he ran a small business producing interpretive signs, books and pamphlets and has lived in Silver City, in Lyon County, for 30 years.
Obermayr lost the November 5, 2024 general election for Nevada State Assembly District 39 to incumbent Ken Gray.
In his 2024 survey, he called for opening primary elections to nonpartisan voters by giving them their choice of party ballots.
